txt: A burly man hangs out by the water lock, carving up a generous serving of salami with an old hunter's knife. His eyes are fixed on a man stranded on the other side of the water lock -- and on an enormous billboard that has fallen down into the canal between them.
The man watches you in silence, very slowly cutting off another slice of his salami and putting it in his mouth.
"'Fraid I can't hang out and chat." He looks west, across the water, chewing on a piece of salami. "Damned water lock's finally been fixed, so I've got to get going."
"*Very* good stuff. Anything I can do for you, officer?" The man on the water lock picks the skin off a slice of a salami and takes a sizeable bite.
"Bah! I've handled enough heavy machinery in my day."
"Barry! Can you hear me, buddy?"
"Can't believe no one's coming to fix this till Wednesday..."
"Cheers!" He salutes you with a half-eaten piece of salami.
"Evening, officer!"
"G'day to you, officer!"
"Good morning to you, officer!"
"Great! Just drop in on Wednesday if you want to see the water lock at work. They say the canal crew will be here at 07.15." He cuts a fresh slice from his salami.
"Have you ever made a water lock move yourself?" he adds, gesturing toward the water lock control panel to his right. "It's quite the thing. Makes a man feel real powerful."
"High time I got moving up the coast. But please, officer, after you."
"I wasn't here to witness it, but those look like tyre tracks on that sign. Weird, huh? Then again, plenty of daredevil drivers in Revachol."
"It'll be restarted on Wednesday morning." He nods his head towards the control panel. "You wanna do the honours when the time comes?"
"It's supposed to operate the water lock, but as noted... it's all junk right now. Disabled because of the blockage."
"My friend Barry is stuck on the other side."
"My friend Barry the Butcher is stuck on the other side of the water lock. I'm keeping him company -- and eating his salami."
"Safety measure. Turns out the panel needs a special key to be re-activated. Wouldn't want anyone moving the water lock with debris still in the channel."
"So, wanna do the honours now?"
"Suit yourself. Just drop by on Wednesday if you want to see the water lock work again." He cuts a fresh slice from his salami.
"Sure thing." He cuts off a slice of salami.
"That butter sign is a write-off for sure."
"Too bad it also takes a year and a day to repair anything 'round here -- especially a water lock. The rest of the coast is closed off till then."
"Uhm... I haven't seen any *cryptologists* around here, but sure -- if they're on the other side, they're stuck. Like my friend Barry."
"Want some too, officer?" he turns to the lieutenant.
"Welcome back, officer."
"Well, there's the fishing village. An abandoned fish market. A bizarro church. Not much use to the congregation, though -- there always seems to be something wrong with it." He thinks for a moment.
"Yeah, not really much else. Just bombed-out ruins."
